content.text: 开始处理：本机独有文件迁到新路径，再建兼容软链，最后删掉旧树残骸。

input.command:
cd /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode && set -e
BACKUP="$HOME/Desktop/CHcode-reorg-leftovers-20261121"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP"

echo "== 1) rescue unique locals =="

# omdb/tgbot (gitignored, never moved by git mv)
if [ -d omdb/tgbot ] && [ ! -e data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot ]; then
  mkdir -p data-jobs/archive/omdb
  mv omdb/tgbot data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot
  echo "moved omdb/tgbot -> data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot"
fi
if [ -f omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf ]; then
  mkdir -p data-jobs/archive/omdb/.claude/database
  if [ ! -f data-jobs/archive/omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf ]; then
    mv omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf data-jobs/archive/omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf
    echo "moved omdb my.cnf"
  else
    mv omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf "$BACKUP/omdb_my.cnf"
    echo "backed up duplicate omdb my.cnf"
  fi
fi

# prod_monitor.env
if [ -f prod_monitor/monitor.env ]; then
  if [ ! -f data-platform/dc-platform-server/monitor/monitor.env ]; then
    mv prod_monitor/monitor.env data-platform/dc-platform-server/monitor/monitor.env
    echo "moved monitor.env"
  else
    mv prod_monitor/monitor.env "$BACKUP/monitor.env"
  fi
fi

# pipeline-runner local step
if [ -f pipeline-runner/steps/funnel_backfill.json ]; then
  mkdir -p data-platform/pipeline-runner/steps
  if [ ! -f data-platform/pipeline-runner/steps/funnel_backfill.json ]; then
    mv pipeline-runner/steps/funnel_backfill.json data-platform/pipeline-runner/steps/funnel_backfill.json
    echo "moved funnel_backfill.json"
  else
    mv pipeline-runner/steps/funnel_backfill.json "$BACKUP/funnel_backfill.json"
  fi
fi

# ops reports
mkdir -p data-jobs/archive/spark_legacy/spark_migrate/reports
for f in ops_system/spark_migrate/reports/*.md; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$f")
  if [ ! -f "data-jobs/archive/spark_legacy/spark_migrate/reports/$base" ]; then
    mv "$f" "data-jobs/archive/spark_legacy/spark_migrate/reports/$base"
    echo "moved report $base"
  else
    mv "$f" "$BACKUP/$base"
  fi
done

# root docs adhoc scripts (never tracked)
mkdir -p data-platform/docs
for f in docs/_smoke_metric_library_visual.sh docs/metric_library_batch1_active_fill_20260922.py docs/metric_library_batch_rest_fill_20260922.py docs/metric_library_batch_rest_promote_20260922.py; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$f")
  if [ ! -f "data-platform/docs/$base" ]; then
    mv "$f" "data-platform/docs/$base"
    echo "moved docs/$base"
  else
    mv "$f" "$BACKUP/$base"
  fi
done

# vscode unique prompts + settings
if [ -f vscode-extension/server-mcp/prompts/a2a3/playbook/dev_platform_dev.md ]; then
  mkdir -p data-platform/vscode-extension/server-mcp/prompts/a2a3/playbook
  for f in vscode-extension/server-mcp/prompts/a2a3/playbook/dev_platform_dev.md vscode-extension/server-mcp/prompts/a2a3/playbook/dev_platform_publish.md; do
    base=$(basename "$f")
    dest="data-platform/vscode-extension/server-mcp/prompts/a2a3/playbook/$base"
    if [ ! -f "$dest" ]; then mv "$f" "$dest"; echo "moved $base"; else mv "$f" "$BACKUP/$base"; fi
  done
fi
if [ -f vscode-extension/.vscode/settings.json ]; then
  mkdir -p data-platform/vscode-extension/.vscode
  if [ ! -f data-platform/vscode-extension/.vscode/settings.json ]; then
    mv vscode-extension/.vscode/settings.json data-platform/vscode-extension/.vscode/settings.json
    echo "moved vscode settings.json"
  else
    mv vscode-extension/.vscode/settings.json "$BACKUP/vscode-settings.json"
  fi
fi

# vsix → backup (不留在仓根)
mkdir -p "$BACKUP/vsix"
shopt -s nullglob 2>/dev/null || true
for f in vscode-extension/*.vsix; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  mv "$f" "$BACKUP/vsix/"
  echo "backed up $(basename "$f")"
done

# dc-platform-server local secrets/scripts
if [ -f dc-platform-server/.env ]; then
  if [ ! -f data-platform/dc-platform-server/.env ]; then
    mv dc-platform-server/.env data-platform/dc-platform-server/.env
    echo "moved server .env"
  else
    mv dc-platform-server/.env "$BACKUP/dc-platform-server.env"
  fi
fi
mkdir -p data-platform/dc-platform-server/scripts
for f in dc-platform-server/scripts/*.py; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$f")
  dest="data-platform/dc-platform-server/scripts/$base"
  if [ ! -f "$dest" ]; then mv "$f" "$dest"; echo "moved script $base"; else mv "$f" "$BACKUP/$base"; fi
done

echo "== 1 done =="
ls -la "$BACKUP" | head -30
du -sh "$BACKUP"

cd /Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode && set -e

echo "== 2) compat symlink for omdb/tgbot =="
# clean remaining omdb husk then recreate symlink layout
find omdb -type f ! -name '.DS_Store' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
# remove empty husk
rm -rf omdb
mkdir -p omdb
ln -s ../data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot omdb/tgbot
# also expose .claude database cnf path if scripts need omdb/.claude
mkdir -p omdb/.claude
ln -s ../../data-jobs/archive/omdb/.claude/database omdb/.claude/database
ls -la omdb omdb/tgbot | head -20
test -f omdb/tgbot/bot_import_smoke.py && echo tgbot_symlink_OK
test -f omdb/.claude/database/my.cnf && echo cnf_symlink_OK

echo "== 3) delete leftover junk trees =="
# confirm nothing unique left
for d in vscode-extension dc-platform-server ops_system pipeline-runner prod_monitor; do
  echo "--- remaining in $d ---"
  find "$d" -type f ! -name '.DS_Store' ! -path '*/node_modules/*' ! -path '*/out/*' ! -path '*/__pycache__/*' ! -path '*/.venv-local-test/*' ! -name '*.pyc' ! -name '*.map' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
done

# safe delete
rm -rf vscode-extension dc-platform-server ops_system pipeline-runner prod_monitor
echo "removed 5 leftover trees"

# docs: only stub runbook should remain (tracked)
find docs -type f ! -name '.DS_Store' 2>/dev/null
ls -la docs/

echo "== 4) status =="
git status -sb | head -40
echo '--- untracked tops ---'
git status -u --porcelain | awk '{print $2}' | awk -F/ '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
ls -d data-platform data-jobs omdb vscode-extension dc-platform-server ops_system 2>&1
du -sh omdb data-jobs/archive/omdb/tgbot 2>/dev/null
